file.title: I have a file
file.body: Attach your 3D model to the request: the workshop checks it before replying with a personalized quote.

studio.title: I don't have a file
studio.body: Customise a vase, a business card, a mountain or a name tag in the Studio, then send it to the workshop.

hints.email: The workshop replies to this address.

file.noscript: To attach a file, turn on JavaScript or write to {email}.
file.required: Attach a readable 3D file (STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP): it is required for the workshop to reply.
file.estimateApprox: open or overlapping mesh, approximate estimate
file.estimateFailed: We could not read this file. Export it as STL or 3MF.
file.stepFailed: We could not read this STEP file. Export it as STL or 3MF.
file.timeout: Reading this file takes more than 20 seconds. Export it as a lighter STL or 3MF.
file.empty: This file has no printable volume (empty or open mesh). Export it as a closed STL or 3MF.
file.tooSmall: This model is smaller than 2 mm: the unit is probably wrong (inches? metres?). Export it again in millimetres.

studioCard.noFile: No file attached: the request contains the configuration link.
studioCard.prefilled: Fields prefilled from the Studio: you can correct them.

errors.400: The file could not be read: it may be empty or damaged. Check it and try again.
errors.413: This file is larger than 30 MB. Shrink it or write to {email}.
errors.415: Unsupported format. Send an STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP file.
errors.429: Too many uploads from this connection (10 per hour). Try again later or write to {email}.
errors.network: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: The file could not be prepared. Try again, or write to {email}.
errors.color: A colour you chose no longer has enough stock for your piece. Choose another one.

success.title: Received.
success.form: The workshop reviews your request and replies by email within 48 hours.
success.studio: The workshop checks your part and replies within 48 hours with a firm price.

colorsPicker.hint: Up to {max} colours, among those with enough stock for your piece.
colorsPicker.pending: Once your file is read, those that fall short are greyed out.
colorsPicker.none: No colour in stock is enough for this piece. Describe the colour you want in your project: the workshop will reply.
colorsPicker.unavailable: The stock could not be read. Describe the colour you want in your project.

preview.title: Your piece
preview.caption: Preview of your file, read in your browser, at real scale and in the chosen colour.
preview.captionFirstColor: Preview of your file, read in your browser, at real scale and in the first chosen colour.
